caption: The drawing depicts a single low-heeled shoe shown in side profile at the bottom right, colored in a pale cream or off-white tone with a brown sole and heel. This shoe features a decorative bow or ribbon on the upper surface near the toe and additional ribbon or ties extending from the back. Above and to the left of the side view are two outline sketches of the same shoe: one is a top view with minimal interior details and a depiction of the ribbon or tie, and the other is a simple outline of the shoe’s sole. The shoe occupies the lower portion of the composition, while the two linear sketches are positioned to the upper left. The background is plain and beige. The drawing primarily uses soft pencil lines with subtle shading and minimal color application, emphasizing the pale color of the shoe and the dark brown of the heel.
title: Slipper
